review_notes.detail: This page alone was checked against its native overview, all four six-card native contacts, all four calibrated route bands, control/input grid, output reference bands, connector table and footer. Numeric 3/4 prefixes, real border wedges, all physical AR outputs and every card/grid/ID/label were checked. Source anomalies were preserved.

Restored four separate unlabeled AR function-row outputs feeding the upper A gates; moved the starred AR output legends to their printed terminal rows. Starred outputs drive the native upward continuations independently. Corrected each native OR bend and stored-Q return row; input names now start at c0 with no blank and wire begins immediately after the name.

Native connector columns independently read at [35, 49], with two-cell indentation for unlabelled continuation rows; revision c173/r93. Native footer DATE, LOG403 at c223/r98, FRAME c227/r98, BLK. preserved.

Native footer BLK. DG was independently read from this page; final G agrees with the same-page LOG G letterform, correcting the former digit 6. DATE/05-28-70, LOG403, FRAME02, MACH.7201-02 and part 2585877 retained.
Final corrected preview awaits root acceptance.
